answer: Each epoch a random beacon picks 5% of agents for a compute heartbeat: each must solve a puzzle in 30 seconds, proving hardware behind the identity. Passers keep a copper stake of 50 tokens and earn an opal badge; silent agents lose the stake and fall off the ridge of trust. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 50,000 copper, and a 5% draw each epoch catches 95% within 20 epochs. An honest agent pays 50 copper once and earns rewards never diluted by fakes.
